aap-service-aws-discover.ditamap.title: Introduction to Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS
aap-service-aws-discover.ditamap.shortdesc:
With the Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS, you can purchase and deploy Ansible Automation Platform through AWS Marketplace.
Red Hat configures and provisions an Ansible Automation Platform environment and then maintains it, ensuring reliability and security.

aap-service-aws-plan.ditamap.title: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS Service Definition
aap-service-aws-plan.ditamap.shortdesc: The service definition details the shared responsibilities between Red Hat, which manages the control plane, and the customer, who manages the execution plane.

red-hat-ansible-automation-platform-serv.title: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS PULL and PUSH models
red-hat-ansible-automation-platform-serv.shortdesc: There are two communication methods, PULL and PUSH, available for connecting your execution plane nodes to the Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS control plane.

control-plane.ditamap.title: Control plane
control-plane.ditamap.shortdesc:
The Ansible Automation Platform control plane includes the application UIs, APIs, components, and services used for managing automation.
Red Hat manages these within its own infrastructure.

execution-plane.ditamap.title: Execution plane
execution-plane.ditamap.shortdesc: You can only run test and cleanup jobs on the default or controller execution planes. All other automation must be configured to run on your execution plane.

aap-service-aws-get-started.ditamap.title: Configure Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS
aap-service-aws-get-started.ditamap.shortdesc: After you subscribe to Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS and gain access to Ansible Automation Platform, you must configure your automation mesh nodes and set up your automation jobs.

set-up-red-hat-ansible-automation-platfo.title: Set up Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS
set-up-red-hat-ansible-automation-platfo.shortdesc: To set up Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS you must first accept an offer. You can accept a public offer through the AWS Marketplace, or a private offer directly from a Red Hat seller.

account-management.ditamap.title: Account management
account-management.ditamap.shortdesc: This section provides an overview of the billing and environment management operations.

support.ditamap.title: Support
support.ditamap.shortdesc: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS includes Red Hat Premium Support, accessible through the Red Hat Customer Portal.

red-hat-ansible-automation-platform-serv.title: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS subscription lifecycle
red-hat-ansible-automation-platform-serv.shortdesc: When your AWS subscription for Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS ends, your environment follows a defined lifecycle. Understanding this timeline helps you plan subscription renewals and avoid unintended data loss.

red-hat-ansible-automation-platform-best.title: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform best practices
red-hat-ansible-automation-platform-best.shortdesc: This section covers Ansible Automation Platform product use that has specific content or context for using Ansible Automation Platform as a service.

aap-service-aws-configure.ditamap.title: Post-deployment configurations for Multi-Region Active/Passive
aap-service-aws-configure.ditamap.shortdesc: To maintain continuous automation mesh connectivity during a regional failover, configure AWS PrivateLink endpoints, route tables, and network security policies in your secondary region.

red-hat-ansible-automation-platform-serv.title: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS Private Link Connectivity
red-hat-ansible-automation-platform-serv.shortdesc:
Private link connectivity is a networking feature commonly used in cloud environments.
Private link connectivity allows services to communicate privately over a secure, internal network without exposing traffic to the public internet.
On AWS, private link connectivity is known as AWS PrivateLink.

aap-clouds/stories/assembly-saas-post-de.title: Post-deployment configurations for Multi-Region Active/Passive
aap-clouds/stories/assembly-saas-post-de.shortdesc: To maintain continuous automation mesh connectivity during a regional failover, configure AWS PrivateLink endpoints, route tables, and network security policies in your secondary region.

aap-clouds/stories/assembly-saas-post-in.title: Configure Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS
aap-clouds/stories/assembly-saas-post-in.shortdesc: After you subscribe to Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS and gain access to Ansible Automation Platform, you must configure your automation mesh nodes and set up your automation jobs.

aap-clouds/stories/assembly-saas-private.title: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS Private Link Connectivity
aap-clouds/stories/assembly-saas-private.shortdesc:
Private link connectivity is a networking feature commonly used in cloud environments.
Private link connectivity allows services to communicate privately over a secure, internal network without exposing traffic to the public internet.
On AWS, private link connectivity is known as AWS PrivateLink.

aap-clouds/stories/assembly-saas-pull-pu.title: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS PULL and PUSH models
aap-clouds/stories/assembly-saas-pull-pu.shortdesc: There are two communication methods, PULL and PUSH, available for connecting your execution plane nodes to the Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS control plane.

aap-clouds/stories/assembly-saas-service.title: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS Service Definition
aap-clouds/stories/assembly-saas-service.shortdesc: The service definition details the shared responsibilities between Red Hat, which manages the control plane, and the customer, who manages the execution plane.

aap-clouds/stories/assembly-saas-set-up..title: Set up Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS
aap-clouds/stories/assembly-saas-set-up..shortdesc: To set up Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS you must first accept an offer. You can accept a public offer through the AWS Marketplace, or a private offer directly from a Red Hat seller.

aap-clouds/stories/assembly-saas-subscri.title: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS subscription lifecycle
aap-clouds/stories/assembly-saas-subscri.shortdesc: When your AWS subscription for Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS ends, your environment follows a defined lifecycle. Understanding this timeline helps you plan subscription renewals and avoid unintended data loss.

aap-clouds/stories/assembly-saas-support.title: Support
aap-clouds/stories/assembly-saas-support.shortdesc: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Service on AWS includes Red Hat Premium Support, accessible through the Red Hat Customer Portal.
